issues: Minor horizontal overflow: scrollWidth=394 vs clientWidth=390 (~4px). Not visually jarring but a stray element is slightly wider than viewport. Likely a decorative hero preview or badge; consider overflow-x:hidden on #landing-scroll or constrain inner widths.
